title: Integers modulo n and the group of units
description: Division algorithm, greatest common divisors and Bézout's identity, Euclid's lemma; arithmetic in Z_n; U(n) as the multiplicative group of units; Euler's φ function.

title: Cyclic groups
description: Cyclic subgroups and generators, the order of an element, subgroups of cyclic groups are cyclic, the order formula n/gcd(k, n), counting elements by order, roots of unity and the circle group.

title: Permutation and dihedral groups
description: The symmetric group S_n, cycle notation, transpositions and parity, the alternating group A_n, dihedral groups and the symmetries of regular polygons and the cube.

title: Cosets and Lagrange's theorem
description: Left and right cosets, the index of a subgroup, Lagrange's theorem and its consequences for orders of elements and groups of prime order, Fermat's and Euler's theorems.

title: Isomorphisms and direct products
description: Isomorphisms as structure-preserving bijections, invariants under isomorphism, classification of cyclic groups, Cayley's theorem, external and internal direct products.

title: Homomorphisms and the isomorphism theorems
description: Group homomorphisms, kernels and images, the first, second and third isomorphism theorems and the correspondence theorem.

title: Matrix groups and symmetry
description: GL_n, SL_n and the orthogonal group O(n); isometries of the plane; finite symmetry groups and the wallpaper groups.

title: Structure of finite abelian groups
description: The fundamental theorem of finite (and finitely generated) abelian groups; p-groups; solvable groups and composition series.

title: Simple groups
description: Simplicity of A_n for n ≥ 5, use of the Sylow theorems to show that groups of given orders are not simple, and the place of finite simple groups in classification.
